questions.question: A skillset runs the PII Detection skill, but the index has no masked text field populated. What is the most likely cause?

options.text: The data source uses a managed identity
options.why: Authentication to the data source does not affect enrichment mapping.

options.text: No output field mapping or projection maps the skill output to an index field
options.why: Correct. Skill outputs exist only in the enrichment tree until they are mapped.

options.text: The skill is not supported on the Basic tier
options.why: Support is not the issue when the skill runs without errors.

options.text: The index is missing a semantic configuration
options.why: This affects ranking, not field population.

questions.explanation: Map enrichment outputs to index fields with output field mappings or index projections.

questions.question: You must add a value from an internal product-code system to each document during indexing. No built-in skill provides it. What should you use?

options.text: A scoring profile on the product field
options.why: Scoring profiles affect ranking, not enrichment.

options.text: A second index with a lookup field
options.why: This adds storage but does not enrich during indexing.

options.text: The Custom Entity Lookup skill with a regular expression against your database
options.why: This detects entities from a list. It does not call your system.

options.text: A Web API custom skill that calls an Azure Function
options.why: Correct. The skill sends batches of records to your endpoint and reads the results back.

questions.explanation: A Web API skill extends a skillset with your own code.

questions.question: A custom skill endpoint receives records with recordId values r1, r2 and r3. Which response is valid?

options.text: A plain text list of product codes
options.why: The response must be JSON in the documented shape.

options.text: A single object that merges the three results with the id of the batch
options.why: The service expects one result per recordId.

options.text: A values array with one entry for each of r1, r2 and r3, each with data, errors and warnings
options.why: Correct. Every received recordId must be returned.

options.text: Only the records that succeeded, with the failures omitted
options.why: Omitted records cause an error. Failures should be reported in errors or warnings.

questions.explanation: A custom skill returns the same recordId values it received.

questions.question: Technical reports contain tables that fixed-length chunking splits across passages. You want chunks that follow sections and tables. Which skill should you add?

options.text: The Sentiment skill
options.why: It scores opinion. It does not affect chunk boundaries.

options.text: The Language Detection skill
options.why: It identifies the language of text. It does not understand layout.

options.text: The Text Merge skill
options.why: It combines text. It does not chunk by layout.

options.text: The Azure Content Understanding skill
options.why: Correct. It analyses layout and creates semantic chunks that keep structure together.

questions.explanation: The Content Understanding skill provides layout-aware analysis and chunking.

questions.question: You edit a skillset that already processed all blobs. Which two actions help you apply the change cost-effectively?

options.text: Reset the indexer so that all documents are processed again
options.why: Correct. Unchanged blobs are otherwise skipped.

options.text: Delete and upload every blob again
options.why: This works but is costly and unnecessary.

options.text: Switch the search service to a lower tier
options.why: The tier does not decide whether the indexer revisits files.

options.text: Enable enrichment caching so skills with unchanged inputs are not rerun
options.why: Correct. Cached outputs avoid repeated skill costs.

questions.explanation: Reset the indexer, and use caching to avoid paying again for unchanged skill inputs.
